map.风险值 = 背景风险(实龄/体重/孕周) × MoM 校正；MoM = 实测值: Risk = background risk (maternal age/weight/gestation) × MoM correction; MoM = measured value / median for age (AFP, free β-hCG)
map.唐筛风险由实龄背景风险结合血清标志物 MoM 值核算，输出 1:N 的出生缺陷风: Screening risk is computed from age-based background risk combined with serum-marker MoM values, output as a 1:N birth-defect risk.
map.💡 方法：年龄先验风险 × AFP 似然比 × free β-hCG 似然比。高: 💡 Method: age prior risk × AFP likelihood ratio × free β-hCG likelihood ratio. High-risk cutoff 1/270, low-risk cutoff 1/1000. Follow laboratory and clinical standards in practice.

map.孕妇 30 岁、体重 60kg、孕 16 周、AFP 1.0 MoM、free: Woman 30 yrs, 60 kg, 16 wks, AFP 1.0 MoM, free β-hCG 1.5 MoM: age background ~1/963, combined LR ≈1.0, posterior ≈1/963, below 1/1000 = low risk.
map.若 free β-hCG 升至 2.5 MoM（似然比升约 4），posteri: If free β-hCG rises to 2.5 MoM (LR up ~4), posterior ≈1/240, crossing the 1/270 cutoff into high risk; suggest amniocentesis or NIPT review.
map.风险 1/270 是什么意思？: What does a risk of 1/270 mean?
map.表示约 270 例同类孕妇中有 1 例受累胎儿，是传统中孕筛查的高风险截断值；≥: It means about 1 affected fetus per 270 comparable pregnancies; the traditional second-trimester high-risk cutoff—≥1/270 is high risk and needs diagnostic testing.
map.血清学筛查能确诊吗？: Can serologic screening confirm the diagnosis?
map.不能，它只给出风险概率。确诊需羊水穿刺（染色体核型）或绒毛取样，无创 DNA 是: No, it only gives a risk probability. Confirmation needs amniocentesis (karyotype) or CVS; NIPT is advanced screening, not diagnosis.
